our_takes.our-take: The OCBC Rewards Card shines for online and retail shoppers, offering 10X OCBC$ (4 miles equivalent) on eligible spends. Ideal for larger, less frequent purchases, especially in categories with rotating quarterly retailer tie-ups, but bonus rewards are capped at 10,000 OCBC$ per month—factor this in if you’re planning big-ticket shopping sprees. Note exclusions like ShopeePay (MCC 5262) and minimum S$5 spend blocks. A good option for new homeowners or parents setting up, but actively track the changing retailer list to maximize value.
our_takes.good-for:
Cardholders seeking accelerated rewards on online shopping, especially at major retailers like Lazada, Shopee, TikTok Shop, Taobao, Watsons.
Shoppers wanting to maximize rewards on electronics, appliances, and furniture purchases for new homes or renovations.
Couples and families purchasing baby and kids products online and in-store, looking for bonus cashback.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Bonus OCBC$ are capped at 10,000 per month; exceeding that limit means earning only base rewards.
Watch for merchant category exclusions; some shopping-related purchases may not earn bonus rewards.
Interest is high at 27.78%; carrying balances will incur significant costs despite rewards earned.
